slides.title:
Strong Saturn,

columns.label: Strong

lines: People trust you with the keys

slides.closing:
Too much Saturn?
The friend who can’t take a day off

slides.label: Where it shines
slides.title: Saturn by sign
items: Exalted: fair, patient, a good judge
Its own signs: steady builders, loyal workers
slides.closing:
In Pisces now, walking backward
until 10 December

slides.label: The Bhagavad Gita
slides.quote:
Your right is to the work alone,
never to its fruits
body: Do the work; results take their own time
In your chart, Saturn shows where patience pays
